content.text: Done. Added voucher support to invoices. `applyVoucher(invoice, { code, amount })` applies a fixed discount after VAT to draft invoices only. Returns errors NOT_DRAFT (non-draft invoices), VOUCHER_EXISTS (voucher already applied), AMOUNT_INVALID (non-positive integers). Updated `invoiceTotals` to return `{ subtotal, discount, vat, voucher, total }` where total = subtotal - discount + vat - voucher, clamped to 0. Added VOUCHER_EXISTS error code. Added 7 tests covering all scenarios and error conditions. All 118 tests pass.
